name: Mianchu Wang
bio: Hi there 👋 I'm Mianchu, a Research Scientist at IBM Research UK. Before joining IBM, I completed my PhD and worked as a Research Fellow at the University of Warwick. I have been fortunate to be supervised by Prof. Giovanni Montana during my PhD, and guided by Dr Geeth de Mel in my industry research. My research focuses on reinforcement learning and its applications. These days I'm increasingly drawn to large-scale training and algorithms for modern language models.
